name: Sakaida Kakiemon I
bio: Potter of Arita. By the tradition of his family he found a clear red enamel for porcelain in the 1640s, and the milk-white body and sparse red, blue and green painting of his workshop became the Kakiemon style.

milestones.event: Is said to have made the first red overglaze enamel at Arita, by the tradition of the Kakiemon family.
